project.purpose: Compose task-local declared capabilities, interface observations and verification obligations without becoming a source of Runtime, Host, Skills, installed, domain or proof authority.

nodes.label: TaskLocalCircuitContract
nodes.responsibility: Validate and compile one declared task-local stage/port/method/capability graph, then evaluate only its declared required verification gates.
inputs: Task-local circuit manifest: declared stages, typed ports, dependencies, method/capability bindings, verifier gates
Verifier gate result records bound to the exact compiled manifest
outputs: Gate standing distinguishing satisfied, missing, unknown, unsatisfied and unresolved assumptions
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject unknown stage/method/capability references, incompatible port wiring, duplicate input producers, cyclic prerequisites, changed manifest bindings and false required-gate closure. A mechanically satisfied gate set is not domain acceptance or concrete implementation refinement.
nodes.authority: Composition task-local evaluator; does not mint verifier, Runtime, provider, domain or currentness authority
mustNotOwn: Actual consumer coverage outside the caller-declared circuit
acceptance: C02 actually imports the existing C01 compiler/digest/topological contract; the public ordivon-circuit CLI is declared in pyproject.toml. These are SOURCE consumer witnesses, not proof of deployed use.
Compiled manifest and gate evaluation must reject typed graph/authority/scope mismatches; no required gates or UNKNOWN cannot become COMPOSITION_GATES_SATISFIED.
A successful task-local gate calculation cannot imply DOMAIN_ACCEPTED.
formalObligations: Behavioral assume-guarantee for any actual cross-owner composition remains consumer-specific

nodes.label: VerificationObligationImpact
nodes.responsibility: Derive exact task-local verification obligations, resolve declared verifier bindings and conservatively select rechecks following declared dependency/contract/source delta.
inputs: C01 manifest/gates plus declared verification obligations and exact verifier bindings
Changed/unknown refs; optional previous/current task-local graph and caller-declared source scopes
outputs: RECHECK_REQUIRED, UNKNOWN or REUSE_CANDIDATE statuses with unindexed changes, provenance limits and proof-reuse denial
nodes.behavioralContract: A missing binding, cyclic/missing relation, changed declared contract, unknown currentness or unindexed change never becomes verified proof or current application acceptance. Caller-declared dependency completeness must not be represented as owner-certified readset; REUSE_CANDIDATE is never a qualified proof.
nodes.authority: Composition task-local impact selector; verifier and source-system facts remain external
mustNotOwn: Complete installed and dynamic consumer readset
Historical verifier proof truth or present-day deployment approval
acceptance: Existing owner-local test suite checks model/contract change propagation, missing edge, changed dependency and false completeness counterexamples.
Current projection explicitly emits dependencyQualification=CALLER_DECLARED_NOT_OWNER_CERTIFIED and proofReuseAdmissible=false; upgrading without source/install/consumer qualification is forbidden.
Public ordivon-verification-obligations CLI exists; no proven external live consumer is implied.
formalObligations: Conservative dependency-envelope coverage for real dynamic edges
Owner-qualified source/config/proof digest and currentness bridge before proof reuse

nodes.label: InterfaceCompatibilityStanding
nodes.responsibility: Compare one consumer expectation with one exact interface observation, separating interface digest compatibility, source currentness and evidence admissibility.
inputs: Task-local circuit-bound interface observation and its source/current version references
Consumer expectation with required digest, accepted alternates, source kinds and support scope
outputs: Typed compatibility, currentness and admissibility standing with exact evidence digest/references
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject circuit identity mismatch, duplicated alternates and unmatched interface identity/digest. Missing live authority version is CURRENTNESS_UNKNOWN, not current. A declared compatible alternate does not prove behavioral refinement, installed truth or domain acceptance.
acceptance: Public ordivon-interface-contract CLI and exported evaluate_interface are present in current SOURCE.
Exact currentness and digest mismatch/unknown cases remain distinct, and output explicitly keeps domainAcceptanceEstablished=false.
Alternate compatibility is declaration-only until independent consumer behavioral refinement evidence exists.
formalObligations: Behavioral refinement and observability obligations for a real substitution

edges.label: Declared circuit manifest and verifier gates produce scoped obligations; source import from C02 to C01 is independently inspectable

slices.objective: Source-qualified consumer/contract baseline for the three existing Composition responsibilities, not a new graph authority.
acceptance: Source-bound plan, compiled code entrypoints and native tests agree on the declared responsibility/contract boundaries.
Runtime/Host/Gateway/Skills dynamic consumers and installed currentness are separately identified as unqualified unless independently witnessed.
blockers: Actual dynamically selected and installed cross-owner consumers remain outside this SOURCE-only cut.
slices.nextAction: Test direct source import and CLI consumer witnesses, inspect separate installed owner-currentness; never promote this graph to deployed fact.

gaps: C01/C02/C03 are bounded task-local source responsibilities, not global LEGO world coverage.
SuccessorContractR1 currently has CLI/export/own tests but independent production consumer necessity is unqualified, so it is not promoted to a confirmed semantic LEGO here.
Runtime/Host/Gateway/Skills execution currentness, complete dynamic consumers, and formal code refinement are UNKNOWN.

review.claimBoundary: All semantic fields are scoped to exact files and consumer needs; planned status is not installed/runtime/formal admission.
